attributes.probed_form: CANARY VERIFICATION, both directions, run against the FINAL classifier after every change to it. CLEAN at HEAD: sweeping game/sfx/sfx, game/game/combat and game/boss/boss reports none of ProcessSpewItems, ProcessEffects or screen_limitation. DIRTY at pre-fix: `git checkout 416d91fbd^ -- src/game/boss/boss.c`, `git checkout d7ab494d3^ -- src/game/sfx/sfx.c`, `git checkout 97ff75c67^ -- src/game/game/combat.c`, rebuild the three objects, sweep again - all three report, ProcessSpewItems as `target 32.0f / ours 8.0` in the set detector and ProcessEffects `target 0.009999999776482582f @lbl_80348080 / ours 0.5 @@524` plus screen_limitation `"OFF    " (len 7) / "OFF   " (len 6)` in the positional detector. THE CONTROL EARNED ITS KEEP THREE TIMES, and this is the reportable part: the FIRST classifier keyed the multiset on the exact mnemonic and the gravity canary did not fire at all, reporting as ordinary reconstruction debt; the SECOND (multiset) fired but manufactured a false-positive class from pure load-count differences; the THIRD (set) fired on gravity but LOST ProcessEffects. Only the two-detector union with all three artifact filters reproduces all three. A single-direction canary would have passed at every one of those stages.
attributes.residual: 53 positional and 34 set candidates remain enumerated and UNFIXED, with verdicts. VETOED BY OWNERSHIP, not by evidence: 44 of the 53 positional rows are in game/game/player.c, owned this run by lane PL per work_claim.harvest-4.20260901.v1's ownership list, and game/world/camera camera_mode_target is webfrank-PINNED (its source is frozen), and game/world/gauntworld fn_800606FC is owned by lane FR. These are handed over, not closed. Several are strong: player.c PlayerProcessPowerups and PlayerUpdateAtts each read 0.01 where the target reads 0.001, a FACTOR OF TEN on a powerup timer, and create_player_blits reads 0.1f at seven sites where the target reads 64000.0f. JUDGED NOT-A-BUG on inspection: the camera_mode_follow 8.5/3.33333333 pair and the gauntworld sPi/sNegativePi pair are value SWAPS between two adjacent named symbols, which is a commutative-chain ordering artifact (camera's own webfrank mechanism text already records a lbl_80345FD0/lbl_80345FD8 commutative-chain fix in that function); adstream adsInitFromHeader and select serve_blits pair the int-to-float magic 2^52 against a real constant, the misalignment signature named in the law. CAPPED, confirmed real but NOT source-reachable: sfx.c UpdateFXStreak reads 0.4999999995 where the target reads 0.49999999949999996 - ONE ULP apart (3fdfffffff768fa1 vs 3fdfffffff768fa0). Every natural spelling tested (0.4999999995, 0.5-5e-10, 0.5*0.999999999, 0.999999999/2.0, 0.5-1e-9/2) produces OUR bits, and the only short decimal reproducing the target's bits is the 17-digit value itself, so the original was a folded expression this pass could not recover. Writing the 17-digit literal would be a fakematch, so per the Mandatory result policy it is capped rather than committed. Runtime impact is one ULP, i.e. none.
attributes.scope: FIVE VALUE FIXES, each its own commit, each followed by a full `ninja -j2` printing build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK. (1) adc292074 src/game/pb/pb_objregs.c setChrome: `3.14159265358979323846` -> `3.141592654` at both degree-conversion sites; the target reads lbl_80348FA8 whose bytes 40 09 21 FB 54 52 45 50 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the game's own named constant sPi, which is the corroboration that settled it. (2) e921c912e src/game/ui/auxscreen.c calc_good_wiz_attn: `1.5707963267948966` -> `1.570796327` (target lbl_80345A38, the same 10-digit truncation family). (3) 35330eaa3 src/game/anim/action.c DoPlayerAction: `0.0666667f` -> `0.066667f` (target lbl_803489E4 = bytes 3D 88 88 B5). (4) 1fec44477 src/game/enemy/critter.c CritterExpCollide: `dot > 0.0` -> `dot > -1.0`; the target loads lbl_80346550 = -1.0 into f29 and branches on `fcmpo cr0,f31,f29` with f31 = the `dot` parameter (proved from the prologue's `fmr f31,f2`). (5) 0b3717f3d src/game/game/pmotion.c: all three PlyrSfxDoDamage call sites passed lbl_80347B30 (0.0f) as the t0 argument where the target passes lbl_80347BC8 (-1.0f); added the extern and switched all three. GAMEPLAY SIGNIFICANCE: fixes 4 and 5 are behavioural, not cosmetic - CritterExpCollide's -1.0 is the 'no facing restriction' sentinel, so our 0.0 was applying a half-space test retail skips for any threshold in (-1.0, 0.0], and the pmotion sites were passing a zero damage-scale argument where retail passes -1.0. Fixes 1-3 are source-fidelity corrections with negligible runtime effect. attributes.verification: Per fix: a clean-state probe.py BASELINE banked BEFORE the first edit of every function touched (the FIRST-BASELINE TRAP honoured throughout), then defake_gate.py baseline per TU, then defake_gate.py check --rebuild = GATE OK, then a full `ninja -j2` printing build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK. setChrome real 0 and CritterExpCollide real 0 both stayed byte-exact across their fixes (fndiff --clean on CritterExpCollide = 'MATCH (pool-name noise only), 0 real diff lines'); calc_good_wiz_attn stayed real 0; DoPlayerAction stayed real 1852 unchanged. PlayerMotion IMPROVED real 3988 -> 3982 and the gate banked it with --update-improved, so the CORRECT value also happened to be the better-scoring one - no score cost was incurred by any fix and none had to be arbitrated against the score. critter.c's 7 webfrank pins, sfx.c's 8 and auxscreen's 1 all replayed clean in the full builds, and no pool-population change forced a wf_rederive_pin.py run. git status clean at close; the three canary TUs were restored to HEAD and rebuilt after every historical checkout.

held_fixed: Every fix changed exactly one constant VALUE and nothing else: no statement shape, no type, no control flow, no prototype. Each TU was gated alone against its own defake_gate baseline with the rest of the tree constant, so each score reading is attributable to that one value.
